data.desc: No one knows noodles like Noodles. Since 1995, Noodles & Company has brought guests craveable, expertly prepared noodle dishes through a menu that blends classic comfort with bold, globally inspired flavors. From longtime favorites like Wisconsin Mac & Cheese and Japanese Pan Noodles to new ways to experience the world of noodles, Noodles draws on more than 30 years of noodle expertise to create dishes that deliver comfort, discovery, and connection in every bowl. With more than 390 restaurants, Noodles & Company continues to bring together fresh ingredients, chef-curated dishes, and flavors inspired by noodle traditions from around the world. Recognized by Newsweek as one of America's Favorite Restaurants and Best Loyalty Programs and honored by Forbes and QSR as a top employer, Noodles continues to show there's always more to discover when you know noodles.
